records.public_claim_text: Since 2007 the Logistics Performance Index (LPI) initiative has emphasized the importance of efficient supply chains in connecting firms to markets, reducing trade costs, and supporting development.2 Logistics performance supports economic development by enabling trade within and across borders.3 Economics literature, often using the survey- based LPI, has established that logistics performance positively and significantly im pacts the volume and value of bilateral trade, in particular exports.4 Logistics influences the time required for a product to reach its market.
